invariants.rationale: It is typical for methods handling collections to expect non-null arguments; this avoids NullPointerExceptions on use.
If the list is non-empty, its elements should generally be non-null for downstream processing.
List.size() in Java is always non-negative; this is a property of the List interface.
The declared type is List, so it should not be a Set; this would be an error in most usages.
